description: Creates a report draft for a website and starts reading it. Free plan: one website, one report every 30 days. A new draft for a different website deletes the user's unfinished draft for the old one, so ask the user first. Returns 202 Accepted with the report, a job object and a Location header: poll that URL (GET /api/v1/reports/{reportId}) every few seconds until stage is needs_confirmation, then call the start endpoint. Send an Idempotency-Key header so a retry cannot start a second report. Needs login with scope reports:write.

country.description: Optional two-letter country. Send with language, or omit both to detect from the site.

website.description: The website to measure, like yourcompany.com. Public sites only.

name: create_report
title: Start a report for a website
